name: OptGod
description: Android64 performance profiler with instrumented experimental render culling; reports object visit, protection, bounds-check and cull counters.

experimental-render-culling.name: Experimental render culling
experimental-render-culling.description: Experimental: skip drawing distant ungrouped non-Effect objects. Logs whether enabled and counts visited, eligible, protected, checked and culled objects. Disabled by default.
